summary: Releases come in batches: a PR adds an unreleased entry, a release is cut on purpose, and apps sync only cut releases
appCreator: A harness sync now brings in cut releases only: a change merged in app-studio reaches the app with the next release, and a release that batches several changes shows as one line with its changes listed under it
Until an app has pulled this release, its start-up note can say the harness is behind while changes wait for a release; a sync then reports it is in step
notVerified: The first real cut with finish release has not run yet (this PR releases itself with --release-now); it is covered by tests in a temporary repo only
The two reworded main scenarios (sync-report-and-gate, sync-report-once) were not run live: they run only after a loader change
A sync from one of the three real apps (old harness copies) was not tried; phase C covers it
The Project's own instructions text still has the old sentence until the coordinator applies docs/studio-project-instructions.md
